title: Evanson Asset Management LLC Decreases Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
Evanson Asset Management LLC decreased its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.6% during the second quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 124,447 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 3,360 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises about 4.6% of Evanson Asset Management LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 4th largest position. Evanson Asset Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $23,036,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other institutional investors have also added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. WASHINGTON TRUST Co increased its stake in Apple by 1.5% during the fourth quarter. WASHINGTON TRUST Co now owns 310,309 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $52,513,000 after acquiring an additional 4,584 shares during the period. QCI Asset Management Inc. NY grew its stake in shares of Apple by 0.7% in the 4th quarter. QCI Asset Management Inc. NY now owns 161,102 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $27,263,000 after purchasing an additional 1,187 shares during the period. Fernwood Investment Management LLC grew its stake in shares of Apple by 12.7% in the 4th quarter. Fernwood Investment Management LLC now owns 14,393 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,436,000 after purchasing an additional 1,620 shares during the period. Asset Management Advisors LLC grew its stake in shares of Apple by 4.8% in the 4th quarter. Asset Management Advisors LLC now owns 39,372 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,663,000 after purchasing an additional 1,804 shares during the period. Finally, Grimes & Company Inc. grew its stake in shares of Apple by 4.3% in the 4th quarter. Grimes & Company Inc. now owns 112,857 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $19,099,000 after purchasing an additional 4,669 shares during the period. 58.54% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $225.74 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $150.24 and a 52-week high of $229.67. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31. The firm has a market cap of $1,105.66 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 24.51, a PEG ratio of 1.98 and a beta of 1.33. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business earned $1.67 EPS. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 earnings per share for the current year.
Several research firms have recently weighed in on AAPL. Morgan Stanley reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $245.00 price objective (up from $232.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, September 5th. DA Davidson reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $265.00 price objective (up from $230.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, September 5th. DZ Bank reiterated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, September 3rd. Canaccord Genuity reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $250.00 price objective (up from $220.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, September 4th. Finally, Cascend Securities upped their price objective on Apple from $230.00 to $250.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, September 4th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have assigned a buy rating to the stock. The stock presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $220.78.
In other news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,652 shares of the stock in a transaction on Monday, July 9th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.18, for a total value of $2,976,697.36. Following the transaction, the chief operating officer now owns 125,258 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $23,821,566.44. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is accessible through the SEC website . Also, insider Craig Federighi sold 47,796 shares of the stock in a transaction on Thursday, August 9th. The shares were sold at an average price of $207.50, for a total value of $9,917,670.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 412,571 shares in the company, valued at approximately $85,608,482.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last ninety days, insiders have sold 378,400 shares of company stock worth $81,052,754. Company insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
